answer: Latency-weighted identity seasoning.** Each new identity starts on a slow voyage: its actions carry a validity delay that halves with age, from 30 days down to hours. To act fast now, an attacker must pre-age identities across many isolated pools, paying hosting and idle-capital costs for each one. Crossing into a shared oasis of fast settlement requires a continuous reputation trail, so every fake island must be maintained independently for months before it can transact at speed.
